faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIITM Gwalior Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 30th August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed M.Tech/M.S./M.E. or equivalent in CSE/IT/EC/EE/ME, along with a B.Tech/B.E./M.Sc. in the same fields. Additionally, they must have qualified in GATE/CSIR-UGC NET.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow position will be as per the ANRF/DST norms, which are standard guidelines for research fellows.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position announced by IIITM Gwalior.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIITM Gwalior located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Information Technology & Management Gwalior (IIITM Gwalior) is located in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 474015.

faq.answer: The job type for the Junior Research Fellow position is contractual, meaning it is for a fixed term as per the project requirements.
